events.title: My Daddy is Haunted! - An Original Horror Comedy
events.summary: Horror comedy performance at PLANET ANT THEATRE. Hammer Horror meets National Lampoons Vacation in the original horror comedy, My Daddy is Haunted! 164 years ago, Sterling Mandrake was accused of heresy and burned alive by a righteous nun. Since then, his castle lay dormant, perched upon a crumbling mountain. That is until the Maplesquatch family arrives for a vacation they’ll never forget! The fun soon turns to terror as something starts to happen to dear old dad. Is that creepy painting alive? What’s with all the bugs? Is their daddy haunted? Come find out for yourself. If you dare! Special Halloween show with costume karaoke after party!
